result.title: FlexGlue: Sparse-to-Dense Feature Matching and Visual Disambiguation
result.summary: To estimate correspondences across images, existing approaches match either sparse interest points, which is highly efficient but limited by repeatability, or dense pixel grids, which is robust but expensive. Furthermore, these approaches are trained with only matching pairs and thus often fail to reject unrelated pairs that exhibit visual symmetries, which is equally important in applications like Structure-from-Motion (SfM). We bridge these gaps by introducing FlexGlue, a neural network for asymmetric sparse-to-dense matching and disambiguation. Given two images and coordinates of points in the first image, FlexGlue estimates the coordinates of the corresponding points in the second image while simultaneously rejecting the pair if non-matching. By searching for a limited set of correspondences among dense pixels, our approach is both fast and effective at both matching and disambiguation: it combines the sub-pixel accuracy of dense matching with the speed of sparse matching, while rejecting incorrect pairs with high precision. Experiments on multiple datasets show that FlexGlue pushes the Pareto frontier in relative pose estimation and significantly outperforms existing approaches for SfM and visual localization. FlexGlue is publicly available at https://github.com/cvg/flexglue .

AI.brief_summary: FlexGlue 提出一种非对称稀疏到稠密的特征匹配网络：给定第一图的点坐标，在第二图的稠密像素中搜索有限对应点，以兼顾稀疏匹配的速度与稠密匹配的亚像素精度，并同时判别并拒绝错误配对。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作属几何视觉的跨图特征匹配与 SfM/定位应用，未涉及 VLM 内部推理状态、视觉证据筛选或停止决策，与 LVR 主线缺少实质联系，也无具体可迁移线索。
